intro: SEPT Lab is actively looking for motivated PhD, MS, and undergraduate students who are passionate about systems and security. Applicants from diverse backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply. The [research](research.html) and [publications](publications.html) pages describe the lab's current work, and the [People](people.html) page lists current members.

audiences.title: Prospective PhD students
audiences.subject: [SEPT PhD]
body: PhD applications are submitted through USC Viterbi Graduate Admission. See the [Ph.D. application information](https://viterbigradadmission.usc.edu/doctoral/) for requirements and deadlines, and the department's [Ph.D. program page](https://www.cs.usc.edu/academic-programs/phd/) for program details. If you are interested in joining SEPT Lab, feel free to reach out to Prof. Li by email.
